programmes.d: Watch Neil and his team swim with these ocean giants in a mesmerising and magical sequence as Neil comes face to face with one of the most intelligent mammals in the ocean.
Follow the team as they collect samples for an exhibit that will educate local school children on the unique species and tiny life that lives within these golden rainforests of the ocean.
The crew look back and reveal their favourite moments, close calls and toughest challenges, and we discover just exactly what it took for Neil to become Bermuda’s Ocean Vet.
From the world’s biggest polluter to a powerhouse of green innovation, China’s fight for survival begins now.
'Deep Rising' narrated and executive produced by Jason Momoa, takes viewers on journey from the oceans depths to the future of sustainable energy.
Modern naval boarding teams train to enforce embargoes, stop smugglers, and confront armed pirates in some of the toughest maritime operations.
Modern tech is reshaping battlefields and training. This episode explores simulators and tools that prepare soldiers for combat.
Modern warfare spans land, sea, and air. This episode explores training for Full Spectrum Warfare across all environments.
Airborne artillery brings heavy firepower behind enemy lines. At Fort Bragg, we witness elite crews train with precision, strategy, and skill.
Paratroopers are elite troops, tougher and faster than foot soldiers. We join the 82nd Airborne training for high-risk, behind-enemy-lines missions.
Ship divers tackle dangerous missions at sea, from clearing nets and mines to rescuing lives. We explore their intense training and high-stakes work.
Combat Casualty Care trains soldiers to save lives on the battlefield, ensuring rapid response to injuries from IEDs and other deadly threats.
Pathfinders are elite paratroopers trained to go behind enemy lines, lead air insertions, gather intelligence, and execute high-risk, deadly missions.
Elite Forces are specially trained soldiers who carry out extreme, high-risk missions anywhere in the world, anytime they’re needed.
Thanks to secret, recently discovered microfilm, Hitler's last secret is revealed: a sprawling underground headquarters at Książ Castle.
50 km north of Rome lies the greatest hideout in fascist Italy’s history: The Monte Soratte Bunker, with security features even a Bond villain could only dream of.
Paranoid and isolated, Albanian dictator Enver Hoxha establishes his bunkerization project, which would result in the construction of more than 170,000 bunkers.
Infamous for the bunkers constructed during World War II and throughout the Cold War, Stalin’s hideouts have maintained a shroud of secrecy for decades, and are now seen for the first time.

Having stolen billions from the populace, Ukrainian dictator Viktor Yanukovych hides his treasure trove in a mind-bending corruption scheme that leads to Mezhyhirya, a 150-acre estate, with secret underground tunnels.

programmes.t: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Ceausescu's Delusions of Grandeur"
programmes.d: Casa Poporlui is the magnum opus of Romania’s most bloodthirsty dictator, Nicolae Ceausescu, and hides secrets of an extensive underground bunker system.
Travel across the continent, exploring the opulent villas, luxurious palaces, remote command centers, underground tunnels, and secret bunkers of Europe’s most tyrannical dictators.

programmes.t: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Information Is Power"
programmes.d: Cold War secrecy accelerates spy tech, satellite surveillance, and early computer networks, laying the foundation for modern global communications.

programmes.t: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Race to Space"
programmes.d: Superpower rivalries turn missile tech toward orbital supremacy, driving historic milestones from early satellite launches to landing on the moon.

programmes.t: Bright Now S1 - "Search for Japan's Lost Supersub"
programmes.d: The I-400 was one of the Imperial Japanese Navy's Sen Toku-class submarines, which were the largest submarines ever built before the age of nuclear-powered subs.

At Santa Pod raceway, engineer and driver Jon Webster reveals the final Flying Kestrel to Joel and Nigel McNully, he gives them a tour around the finished car and shows them all the changes he has made, all to hopefully get a land speed record.

programmes.t: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "Ready to race"
programmes.d: The Flying Kestrel team heads back to the 2 mile long runway at Elvington, where last year Jon Webster crashed the car. He drives it in anger for the first time since that fateful day but have they done enough?

Driver Jon Webster is strapped in and ready to push the Flying Kestrel to its limits.The Kestrel team must overcome multiple problems on the day to stand any chance of topping the time sheets and can Jon keep the kestrel on track and break the record

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Terry's Criminal Mind"
programmes.d: A murderer tries to kill his final victim as the car they are in slowly sinks to the bottom of a lake. The only way to save the victim is to rescue her as the car continues to sink.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Shark Go Boom!"
programmes.d: Here, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a shark on a platform to test if you can hit the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "The Good the Bad and Terry"
programmes.d: In this classic western, Clint Eastwood – aka “Blondie” – saves Eli Wallach from the hangman’s noose three separate times by shooting and severing the rope that he hangs from. We test the reality of these shots with the weapons that were used.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Dying Hard"
programmes.d: John McLain (Bruce Willis) finds himself dangling from the side of a building. The only way to save himself is to shoot through the glass window and break through to safety.

Our host George becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.
Some of the fiercest weather on the planet can be experienced at the southern tip of Argentina and Chile– the area the South Americans call the “Fin del Mundo” – the end of the world.

Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope.
George Kourounis returns to “Tornado Alley” with three of his fellow stormchasers to see what the 2007 Storm Season will bring.
Boats and snow don't belong together. At least not until we get them together in this episode.

programmes.t: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "DNA Archaeology"
programmes.d: Neil Cairns visits archaeologists and geneticists who traced a 20,000-year-old deer tooth pendant to a Stone Age woman.

programmes.t: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Saving the Iberian Lynx"
programmes.d: Reya El-Salahi visits Spain’s Sierra Morena to see how conservation brought the Iberian lynx back from under 100 to thriving again.

programmes.t: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Imaging the Aurora"
programmes.d: Reya El-Salahi explores how the northern lights can disrupt technology and visits EISCAT 3D, a new radar studying solar particle impacts.

programmes.t: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Long COVID"
programmes.d: Emma meets Dr. Asad Khan, whose life was upended by long COVID, as new research seeks answers for millions still suffering worldwide.
Thom Hunt travels to the US to track down Ron White, a man whose mind-blowing memory powers defy belief.
Thom heads to Nevada, to find a man who defies human biology. Igor Zaripov performs mind-blowing feats of power using only the might of his jaw.
